This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the [[Generation IV|fourth generation]] games [[Pokémon HeartGold and SoulSilver Versions]] for the [[Nintendo DS]], per the game's [[credits]]. It was published by [[Nintendo]] and developed by [[Game Freak]] and [[Creatures, Inc.]] All names are given in Western order.
